A_general.open_code_note: The official repository README names https://mcp.excalidraw.com as its recommended remote server. The repository contains the hosted Vercel handler and the same tool registration code; it also supports local stdio use.
other_official_servers: https://api.excalidraw.com/api/v1/mcp — separate Excalidraw+ MCP, documented as public beta; API-key authenticated, route-permission-filtered, and the docs name 37 tools. It is not the input endpoint.

B_access_pricing.pricing_model_details: The official Excalidraw+ pricing page lists Free and Plus plans and shows the MCP feature as public beta for Plus. This applies to the separate Excalidraw+ endpoint, not the unauthenticated input endpoint.

D_server_side_logic.additional_logic: 1. The code annotates read_me and create_view with readOnlyHint; the other three tools have no read-only or destructive hints. create_view persists checkpoint state despite its read-only hint. export_to_excalidraw uploads data; save_checkpoint writes state. 2. The UI release notes describe a confirmation modal before export; no server-enforced confirm parameter or MCP elicitation is present. 3. Input endpoint has no OAuth/API-key gate in public code; no product-user permission inheritance or role checks are implemented. 4. No read-only mode, toolset filter, query-free mode, or endpoint variants are shown in this server code. This project also supports local stdio and self-hosted Vercel deployments. 5. Inputs are capped at 5 MiB by string length; checkpoint IDs are restricted to alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore, max 64 characters. Export encrypts serialized diagram data with AES-GCM before posting it to json.excalidraw.com; the key is placed in the returned URL fragment. 6. create_view, export, and checkpoint input strings have 5 MiB limits. Checkpoint storage is in-memory by default on Vercel or Upstash Redis with 30-day TTL when configured; in-memory store evicts oldest after 100. Local file store prunes oldest over 100. No rate limit or per-call price found. 7. Zod string schemas validate input types. create_view parses JSON and returns an error on invalid JSON; app checkpoint save also parses JSON. Camera aspect ratios outside tolerance trigger a textual suggestion, not a parameter rewrite. 8. Hosted handler logs caught server errors to console. No user-facing audit trail or telemetry found in code. 9. No feedback, rating, report, survey, or upsell tool found. 10. read_me and create_view descriptions and read_me output steer the model; the server does not enforce those drawing recommendations. MCP App UI is bundled with the server. 11. Checkpoint IDs let later calls restore state; hosted in-memory storage is per runtime instance and Redis storage expires after 30 days. 12. The server exposes a single tool set plus an MCP Apps UI resource; app-only tool visibility divides the tools by consumer. 13. No raw API, SQL, script, or arbitrary execution tool is present.
behavioural_instructions_to_ai_verbatim: Returns the Excalidraw element format reference with color palettes, examples, and tips. Call this BEFORE using create_view for the first time.
Call read_me first to learn the element format.
Thanks for calling read_me! Do NOT call it again in this conversation — you will not see anything new. Now use create_view to draw.
ALWAYS start with a `cameraUpdate` as the FIRST element.
For add, send a JSON array string of new element skeletons and do not include id. The server generates persisted IDs for newly added elements.
D_server_side_logic.server_structure_explanation: The MCP Apps extension exposes a UI resource and marks export_to_excalidraw, save_checkpoint, and read_checkpoint as app-only. The code registers five tools, while only two carry no app-only visibility restriction.

E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: A human can directly draw and edit diagrams in Excalidraw; the model-facing tools create a diagram view and read the format reference. No evidence that the input endpoint supports Excalidraw+ workspace operations such as collections, invites, users, or logs; those are documented for the separate https://api.excalidraw.com/api/v1/mcp endpoint.

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: The read_me tool says to call it before the first create_view call; its returned guide says “Do NOT call it again in this conversation”. It also gives drawing, sizing, and element-order recommendations. The server validates JSON and input size but does not enforce most drawing advice.
F_documentation.governance_promises: The export implementation encrypts the serialized diagram before upload and returns a URL containing the decryption key in its fragment. Repository release notes say: “Confirmation modal before upload” and “Encrypts + uploads to excalidraw.com”. No MCP-specific privacy, retention, or AI-training promise was found.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: The README describes the app as rendering hand-drawn diagrams with smooth viewport camera control and interactive fullscreen editing. The listing says the endpoint needs no sign-in.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: Encryption and upload behavior are visible in code. The export confirmation is implemented in the UI flow described in release notes, not enforced by the server tool schema. No MCP-specific privacy or retention commitments were identified.

contradictions: The repository MCPB manifest lists two tools (read_me and create_view), while the server source registers five. The hosted endpoint catalogue listings report all five; actions.json follows the hosted server source.
create_view carries readOnlyHint: true, but its handler saves a checkpoint and returns a checkpoint ID.
The create_view response instructs the agent to call read_widget_context, but no such tool is registered in this server's source; the instruction therefore depends on client-provided context support.
observations_for_research: The two model-facing tools are accompanied by three app-only tools, so the tool list available to a model can differ from the complete server registration.
The read_me result contains extensive behavior and format guidance that shapes diagram generation, while most of the guidance is advisory rather than schema-enforced.
create_view has a read-only annotation despite saving state; this illustrates a gap between declared tool hints and handler side effects.

The server's open-source local stdio option and hosted endpoint share the same repository implementation, whereas Excalidraw+ MCP is a separate product endpoint with a broader permission-filtered tool set.
